name: uberasm-anticheat
title: Anticheat
description:
This is an UberASM port of worldpeace's old "Anticheat" patch. If a player tries to cheat at your ROM hack by enabling various debug features present in the vanilla SMW ROM, Mario will die when entering a level. This is to punish them for doing so. This conversion has a few improvements over the original, such as no longer needing free RAM and checking if more debug routines are enabled.

Insert on game mode 14.
